actions.title: Analyze customer reviews
actions.purpose: Source-linked voice of customer themes, objections, and testable angles.

actions.title: Develop ad concepts
actions.purpose: Ad concepts, UGC script, shoot plan, static direction, and QA.

actions.title: Write a video sales letter
actions.purpose: Timed script with voiceover and a visual plan.

actions.title: Plan an animation
actions.purpose: Scene prompts with character and product continuity.

actions.title: Plan a cinematic shoot
actions.purpose: Shot list, framing, sound, and continuity checks.

actions.title: Render a storyboard preview
actions.purpose: Vertical MP4 preview using captions and supplied images.

actions.title: Prepare an ad asset handoff
actions.purpose: A review CSV with validated paths to local ad assets.

actions.title: Manage creator seeding
actions.purpose: Draft orders and a follow-up queue for creators.

actions.title: Calculate ROAS
actions.purpose: Return on ad spend by ad and currency.

actions.title: Draft a landing page
actions.purpose: Page copy matched to the approved angle and offer.

actions.title: Draft an email sequence
actions.purpose: Email copy, triggers, timing, and exit conditions.

actions.title: Draft a support reply
actions.purpose: A policy-based reply or escalation draft.

actions.title: Create a person matte
actions.purpose: ProRes 4444 MOV with a person mask in its alpha channel.

actions.title: Prepare a Resolve edit
actions.purpose: An editing task with the approved script, evidence, and source assets.

roles.name: Chief of Staff
roles.mandate: Own intake, select the workflow, assign the sprint, verify the deliverable and bring decisions to the owner.

roles.name: Customer Researcher
roles.mandate: Record short customer quotes and observations with stable source IDs, context, and dates. Flag gaps and contradictory evidence.

roles.name: Competitor Researcher
roles.mandate: Compare direct offers and substitutes with market, currency, pack size, terms, and dated sources.

roles.name: Evidence Reviewer
roles.mandate: Check the cited source against the claims and review material fixes. If the host uses one agent, label the review as a self-review.

roles.name: Ad Strategist
roles.mandate: Use reviewed evidence to propose up to three distinct, testable angles and recommend the first test.

roles.name: Video Editor
roles.mandate: Take approved scripts and supplied assets through transcripts, mattes, previews, Resolve preparation, and draft asset handoffs.

roles.name: Office Developer
roles.mandate: Own Evolve HQ code and local workflow integration. Use the technical toolkit and verify changes through the real entry points.

roles.name: Creative Producer
roles.mandate: Translate approved angles and briefs into production-ready concepts, scripts, and shot plans.

roles.name: Creator Coordinator
roles.mandate: Maintain the creator draft-order and follow-up queue for review.

roles.name: Performance Analyst
roles.mandate: Read supplied exports and attribution context, calculate ROAS and identify the evidence for the next test.

roles.name: Lifecycle Lead
roles.mandate: Draft landing pages and email from approved facts, angle, offer, and audience.

roles.name: Support Coordinator
roles.mandate: Draft replies or escalations based on the supplied policies, examples, and ticket.

roles.name: Organic Growth Lead
roles.mandate: Use organic growth workflows for requested content, search, community, and partnerships.
